prompts.prompt: In Azure DNS Private Resolver, how many forwarding rules can a single DNS forwarding ruleset contain? Answer concisely with the number.
prompts.source: plugins/networking/skills/azure-dns/SKILL.md - Up to 1,000 forwarding rules per ruleset, ruleset linkable to multiple VNets

prompts.prompt: In Azure Private DNS, can a single VNet have auto-registration enabled for more than one private DNS zone at the same time? Answer in one sentence.
prompts.source: plugins/networking/skills/azure-dns/SKILL.md - Auto-registration conflict: a VNet can only have auto-registration enabled for one private DNS zone, linking a second fails

prompts.prompt: Does Azure DNS support DNSSEC on private DNS zones, or only on public zones? Answer in one sentence.
prompts.source: plugins/networking/skills/azure-dns/SKILL.md - DNSSEC is NOT supported on private zones
